column1: # Labels and tooltips of this mod's settings window (ModHelper.GetLocalized). Format: key

column2: On: Chinese (克). Off: English (g), e.g. a fish's age （120克） becomes （120g）. Restart the game after changing.
On: Chinese (毫升, 公升, 微升). Off: English (ml, L, uL), e.g. a seed's 耗水率：100毫升/天 becomes 耗水率：100ml/天. Restart the game after changing.
Food calories and power. On: Chinese (千卡, 千焦). Off: English (kcal, kJ). Restart the game after changing.
